name: High Rank Directory

sources.title: High Rank Directory - Submit Link form with pricing table

conditions: Free 'Regular links' are gated by a stated 2-3 MONTH human-editor review queue ('We appreciate your patience but we have to review every listing ahead in the queue')
Paid 'Featured links' at $9.99/year are reviewed within 48 hours by a human editor (fee framed as covering 'an Urgent Manual Review')
requirements: Required fields: Title (*), Your Name (*), Your Email (*), Category (*)
Optional: URL field present, Description (limited), META Keywords (comma-separated), META Description (limited)
Deep category selection from a large topical tree (Arts & Humanities, Business & Economy, Computers & Internet, Health And Medical, etc.)
Login/register box exists on the page but the submit form itself is open
preparation: Site title, URL, description, meta keywords/description
Chosen deep category from the inline tree
workflow: Pick 'Regular links' (free, 2-3 month queue) or 'Featured links' ($9.99/yr, 48h review)
Complete Title, URL, Description, META fields, Name, Email
Submit and wait for the human-editor review
watchFor: The free path's 2-3 month queue is among the longest documented - plan accordingly
Same phpLD-era form family as other legacy directories: no drafts, giant inline category tree
The featured fee is explicitly for faster human review and first-page placement, not guaranteed acceptance
Separate 'Submit Article' endpoint exists for article submissions
countsAsLive: The link renders publicly under its category (verify via 'Latest Links' or the category page) after editor review
unknowns: Actual free-queue turnaround vs the stated 2-3 months
Whether featured placement is permanent or annual-renewal only ('1 Year' duration is stated)
